name: @cmodjs/cli
description: Claude Mod Manager: install, try, build, check, and publish Claude Code mods.

scripts.build: for machine in ${CMOD_MACHINES:-darwin-arm64 darwin-x64 linux-arm64 linux-x64}; do bun build --compile --minify --target=bun-$machine src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmod-$machine || exit 1; done
